name: Chemdawg
summary: Chemdawg is a [[kind:cut|cut]] kept since 1991 by a grower known as Chemdog, from one of 13 seeds found in bud bought at a Grateful Dead show in Indiana. The bud was said to have come from the California–Oregon border. This first keeper, also called Chem 91, is a parent of [[sour-diesel|Sour Diesel]] and is commonly named in the ancestry of [[og-kush|OG Kush]].

sources.title: 25 Years of Chem Dog
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: confirms the June 1991 Deer Creek (Indiana) purchase, the 13 seeds, the California/Oregon-border source, Chem 91 as the first keeper, and the Sour Diesel and OG Kush connections.

sources.title: Chemdawg
sources.note: Describes the seed as Northern California bag seed from a Colorado show — a variant of the same story.
